text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: Spectravideo was a series of home computers released during the early 1980s by SpectraVideo International. The company's systems were among the first computers to combine home computing features with strong gaming capabilities, using the Z80 processor and MSX-compatible hardware in later models. Spectravideo computers supported programming, education, and entertainment, with software available through cartridges, cassette tapes, and disk drives. The company's SV-318 and SV-328 models helped influence the development of the MSX computer standard.
